plain_description.what: It re-read the 599 top-model matches of the STACK-v2 judge run, with no new calls. Three versions of the top-4 leaderboard were built: unweighted, weighted by the judge's confidence, and keeping only verdicts with confidence of 0.95 or more.
plain_description.why: It checks whether trusting only confident judge verdicts gives a leaderboard closer to the true answer-key order.
plain_description.information: If weighting or gating fixed the order, confidence would be a useful filter. If not, it adds nothing. Result: done, descriptive. All three boards give the same order with 1 violation of the answer-key order. Squaring the confidence weight gave the key order, but that was exploratory only. Note: this belongs to the older p2dca data family, which is now classed as history, not evidence.
